name: show_choices
description: Ends every answer: offers the person up to 4 ways to continue. `label` is what the person reads. An option with `followUp` stays on this topic (the app sends that text as the person's next message); `action` starts another topic by its id; `next: true` moves on to the next topic of the guided path. If an option has several, the app uses `action`, then `next`, then `followUp`; an option with only a `label` is a follow-up whose text is its label.

name: save_note
description: Saves what this topic made clear, only when the app asks you to close the topic. Write the note in English. The app writes it into the folder: never write it yourself. `summary`: at most 5 short key points; `decisions`: what was settled; `files`: paths that back the summary; `open`: questions left open.

name: set_phase
description: Asks the app to move this task to another of its parts. `to`: a part id the app gave you; in the last part, its own id means the task is done. `reason`: one short sentence the person may read. Call it once, at the end of your answer, then stop: the app acts after your answer and may ask the person first.

name: job_result
description: Ends this background job with its result: `status` ok, needs-you (name in `action` the action the person should start) or failed, and a one-line `summary`.
